# create-vllnt-app

> Agent-first CLI scaffolder. One command to a production-ready Next.js project with composable sections (landing, blog, dashboard, auth, docs, admin), optional Convex backend (cloud or self-hosted), and AI agent contracts (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, vllnt.json) out of the box.

## Quick Start

```
npx create-vllnt-app
npx create-vllnt-app my-app --preset saas --convex cloud
npx create-vllnt-app my-app --preset landing
npx create-vllnt-app my-app --agent --preset saas --convex cloud
```

## Commands

- `create-vllnt-app [name]` / `vllnt new [name]`: Scaffold a new project from a preset or custom section list
- `vllnt doctor`: Health check for a vllnt project (`--for <section>` preflight, `--json` for agents)
- `vllnt add <feature>` / `vllnt generate <type> <name>`: Reserved — not yet implemented (exit code 1, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` in `--agent` mode)

## Scaffold Options

- `-p, --preset <preset>`: landing | blog | marketing | saas | saas-blog | full-saas | dashboard | admin | docs
- `--sections <sections>`: Comma-separated sections for a custom preset (landing, blog, dashboard, auth, docs, admin)
- `--convex <mode>`: Convex backend mode: `cloud` or `self-hosted`. Required when a backend is included (prompts interactively; errors in `--yes`/`--agent` if omitted)
- `--skip-backend`: Skip Convex backend setup
- `-y, --yes`: Skip prompts, use defaults
- `--agent`: Machine-readable JSON output (implies `--yes`, sets `VLLNT_AGENT=1`)
- `--package-manager <pm>`: npm | pnpm | yarn | bun (auto-detected from lockfile otherwise)
- `--skip-install`: Skip dependency installation

## Presets

- landing: landing | blog: blog | marketing: landing + blog
- saas: landing + dashboard + auth | saas-blog: saas + blog | full-saas: saas + blog + docs
- dashboard: dashboard + auth | admin: dashboard + admin + auth | docs: docs
- custom: interactive section selection

## Convex Backend Modes

- `cloud`: `.env.example` with `NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL`; run `npx convex dev` for a managed deployment
- `self-hosted`: `.env.example` with `CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL` + `CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_KEY`, a `docker-compose.yml` (backend + dashboard), and `docs/self-hosting.md`

## Agent Mode

For AI coding agents and CI/CD pipelines:

```
npx create-vllnt-app my-app --agent --preset saas --convex cloud
```

Returns JSON: `{ success, path, preset, sections[], backend, convexMode, files[], packageManager }`. Errors return `{ success: false, error, message }`.

Set `VLLNT_AGENT=1` to suppress interactive output.

## Ecosystem Packages

- [@vllnt/ui](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/ui): React components (Radix UI + Tailwind + CVA)
- [@vllnt/eslint-config](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/eslint-config): Strict ESLint config for TypeScript
- [@vllnt/typescript](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/typescript): Shared TypeScript configurations
- [@vllnt/logger](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/logger): Structured logging
- [@vllnt/analytics](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/analytics): Privacy-first analytics with consent management
